description: Author the design system (R1) and the shared component library (R2). Populate the empty tailwind.config.js theme.extend with the exact NASA-inspired tokens from docs/astra-redesign-report.md §7.1-7.3/7.5, add Google Fonts + base CSS (reduced-motion, focus-visible, glass-panel, hud-mono), add a reducedMotion flag to the app store + a useReducedMotion hook, and build all reusable token-driven accessible components (Panel, PrimaryButton, StatusBadge, StatReadout, ResourceBar, EventCard, AstroPanel, AppShell, ScreenTransition) plus their unit tests. This is the foundation every screen builds on. No new screens are wired to the router yet — screens are a later FEAT. Build + all tests (91 existing + new component tests) must pass.
steps: Install runtime deps exactly: `npm install framer-motion@11.18.2 @phosphor-icons/react@2.1.10` (saved to dependencies). Both verified React-18 peer-compatible.

Populate tailwind.config.js theme.extend with EXACT tokens: colors.space{void:#060912,deep:#0B1224,panel:#121C33,panelRaised:#1B2A4A}, colors.border{subtle:#243456,strong:#3A5180}, colors.accent{ignition:#FF6B35,orbit:#29E6F3,starlight:#EAF1FA}, colors.status{good:#46E6A0,warn:#FFC93C,crit:#FF5A5F,info:#29E6F3}, colors.text{primary:#EAF1FA,secondary:#A9B8D4,muted:#7E8DAB}; fontFamily.display=['Space Grotesk',system-ui,...], body=['Lexend',...], mono=['Space Mono',...]; borderRadius.xl='12px','2xl'='16px'; boxShadow glow variants (glow.ignition, glow.orbit low-opacity colored) + panel; keyframes/animation fade-in, slide-in-right, pulse-warn, count-up.

index.html: add preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com + fonts.gstatic.com (crossorigin) and the css2 link for Space Grotesk(600;700), Lexend(400;500;600), Space Mono(400;600) with display=swap. Keep existing title/meta.

src/index.css: keep @tailwind directives; add :root CSS custom properties mirroring every token; base body styles (font-family Lexend, background var(--space-void), color var(--text-primary), font-size 18px, line-height 1.6, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased); *:focus-visible outline using --accent-orbit (visible, never removed); @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block setting animation-duration/transition-duration 0.01ms and disabling non-essential transforms (never hiding content); .glass-panel utility (rgba(18,28,51,0.72) + backdrop-filter blur(12px) + border 1px solid #243456 + border-radius 12px); .hud-mono helper (Space Mono).

src/store/app-store.ts: add state field reducedMotion: boolean (init false) and action setReducedMotion(value: boolean). Do NOT call window.matchMedia at module load (jsdom lacks it). Keep all existing actions/state.

src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts: returns { reducedMotion: boolean; toggleReducedMotion: () => void }. On mount guard `typeof window !== 'undefined'`: read localStorage 'astra-reduce-motion'; if unset read window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches (guard undefined -> false); set store + persist; apply document.documentElement.dataset.reduceMotion='true'|''. toggle flips store + localStorage + dataset. SSR/jsdom-safe.

src/components/common/Panel.tsx: props { as?: ElementType; className?: string; children: ReactNode; accent?: 'ignition'|'orbit'|'none'='none'; title?: string }. Glass-panel wrapper with optional accent glow. Accessible heading if title.

src/components/common/PrimaryButton.tsx: props { children: ReactNode; onClick?: ()=>void; to?: string; variant?: 'primary'|'secondary'|'ghost'='primary'; size?: 'md'|'lg'='md'; disabled?: boolean; type?: 'button'|'submit'='button'; ariaLabel?: string; className?: string }. Min height 48px (56px for lg). accent.ignition bg for primary. framer-motion press scale 0.97 + hover lift + focus-visible ring. If `to` provided render as react-router Link wrapping the motion button.
src/components/common/StatusBadge.tsx: props { status: 'good'|'warn'|'crit'|'info'; label: string; icon?: PhosphorIconType }. Pill; maps status->token color; ALWAYS icon + label (never color alone).

src/components/common/StatReadout.tsx: props { label: string; value: string|number; unit?: string; status?: 'good'|'warn'|'crit'|'info'; trend?: 'up'|'down'|'flat' }. Space Mono numeric; trend arrow icon.

src/components/charts/ResourceBar.tsx: props { label: string; value: number; max: number; unit?: string; status: 'good'|'warn'|'crit'; icon?: PhosphorIconType; valueLabel?: string }. Animated fill via framer-motion width (instant when useReducedMotion().reducedMotion). Color from status token. sr-only text node 'label value/max unit'.

src/components/feedback/EventCard.tsx: props { event: EventDefinition; onResolve: (choiceId: string) => void; accent?: 'ignition'|'orbit'='orbit' }. Slide-in from right (framer-motion; instant on reduced-motion). Phosphor event icon + event.title + event.description + one button per event.choices (PrimaryButton; secondary for non-first). aria-label includes the choice label.

src/components/feedback/AstroPanel.tsx: props { messages: readonly AstroResponse[]; isLoading: boolean; onAsk: (kind: AstroAskKind)=>void; reducedMotion: boolean } where AstroAskKind='situation'|'oxygen'|'water'|'food'|'energy'. Floating glass comms panel, cyan glow. Word-by-word reveal via state interval (instant when reducedMotion). Typing indicator when isLoading. Render explanation + optional scienceFact + optional suggestion. Buttons call onAsk.

src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx: props { children: ReactNode; hudSlot?: ReactNode; title?: string }. CSS starfield background (layered radial-gradient stars + drift; static when reduced-motion). Top HUD bar renders hudSlot + Reduce-Motion toggle (useReducedMotion). Visually-hidden h1 from title.

src/components/layout/ScreenTransition.tsx: props { children: ReactNode; routeKey: string }. framer-motion AnimatePresence keyed on routeKey: fade + slight scale/dolly (instant/cross-fade on reduced-motion).

Component tests under tests/unit/components/ (one per file): Panel, PrimaryButton, StatusBadge, StatReadout, ResourceBar, EventCard, AstroPanel, AppShell, ScreenTransition. Assert render, props propagate, a11y (keyboard focus reaches the element, icon + label both present, min 48px target where applicable). Use @testing-library/react + MemoryRouter where navigation is involved.
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config.js theme.extend contains all color/font/radius/shadow/keyframe tokens with the exact hex values listed above
index.html loads the three Google Fonts with preconnect
src/index.css defines :root CSS vars, body styles, focus-visible, a reduced-motion media block, .glass-panel and .hud-mono utilities
app-store has reducedMotion + setReducedMotion; useReducedMotion hook is SSR/jsdom-safe and toggles a persisted localStorage flag + html dataset
All 9 listed components exist, are functional, typed (named interface props), token-driven, accessible (focus-visible, icon+label, 48px+ targets), and have passing unit tests
npm run build exits 0; npm run test -- --run passes (91 existing + new component tests)
verification: npm install framer-motion@11.18.2 @phosphor-icons/react@2.1.10 then npm ls framer-motion @phosphor-icons/react shows both installed
npm run build exits 0 with zero TS errors
npm run test -- --run passes (all existing + new component tests)
